title: Human labels on the internal instance
compared: Failed jobs on the internal instance that a person gave a bug or ticket reference, and the distinct tickets behind them, by class of the ticket.
sample: 60 days of internal job groups; failed, incomplete or timed-out jobs with a reference.

rows.cls: references of more than one class

verdict: 313 jobs on 66 tickets. Where the class of a ticket is known it is nearly always a product bug: 2 test-issue tickets and 0 for infrastructure. Not enough to tune on.
note: 1473 more jobs carried a reference that automation set or carried over; their tickets are the last column. A ticket whose project is not visible without an account is counted as not visible. A job with references of two classes counts once in its own row, and its tickets in their classes.
